question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
-- Count actors who qualify: max_gap <= 4 OR only 1 year
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        mc.PID,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS movie_year
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE mc.PID IS NOT NULL
),
actor_year_counts AS (
    SELECT PID, COUNT(DISTINCT movie_year) as num_years
    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY PID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT PID, movie_year,
           LAG(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY movie_year) AS prev_year
    FROM actor_years
),
max_gaps AS (
    SELECT PID, MAX(movie_year - prev_year) AS max_gap
    FROM ranked
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM max_gaps WHERE max_gap <= 4) 
    + 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor_year_counts WHERE num_years = 1) as qualifying_actors
